rationale: The assistant immediately and correctly explained that 'SA2' is a model series rather than an error code, asked the right first checks (is the fan spinning, does conventional heat, full model from the rating plate), and only pointed to the fan element conditionally on the fan spinning. Once the customer reported hum with no spin, it instructed power isolation before hand-turning the blade, then correctly concluded seized bearings and recommended the fan oven motor for SA2 540 H IX without inventing a part number. The hot smell was handled sensibly (stop using fan modes, no lubricant, inspect for heat-damaged wiring, engineer if found); the only minor gap is that the final message could have restated the engineer option more clearly given the oven needs pulling out and rewiring.
